# instaling-bot

> Open-source bot for practising vocabulary on instaling.pl.
> Desktop app for Windows 10/11 and macOS 13+, Android APK, unsigned iOS IPA,
> Safari/Firefox userscript, and a Node.js 22+ CLI for Linux, macOS and Windows.

## Canonical

- Website: https://bmonekkk.github.io/instaling-bot/
- Repository: https://github.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot
- Latest release: https://github.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot/releases/latest
- Wiki: https://github.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot/wiki

- Mobile architecture: https://github.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot/blob/master/MOBILE_PLAN.md

## What it is

instaling-bot automates vocabulary practice on instaling.pl. It logs in, starts or
resumes a session, reads each prompt, answers with a configurable accuracy, remembers
translations and can make believable mistakes (empty field, different translation or a
typo) for human-like behaviour. Everything runs locally; there is no backend or telemetry.

Version 4.2.2 aligns every platform and fixes the shared navigation-button click speed:
instaling.pl reloads the page on "next", "continue" and session start, and the pause used
to be counted only within one page, so the between-word transition was always as fast as
the page load. The engine now keeps the pause deadline across the reload, on desktop and
on phones, and the desktop also honors it when starting or continuing a session. The
desktop and CLI keep every earlier feature, and a shared engine powers three mobile
variants. Desktop, Android, iOS and the userscript all expose the same week/month/year/all
statistics panel, a "restore defaults" action (keeping login, password and language) and
one shared min/max navigation-button click speed:

- **Android APK** — native WebView shell with Start/Stop, PL/EN, answer counter,
  statistics, a ⚙ settings dialog (accuracy, all typing delays, navigation speed,
  reminder time and a frequency dropdown), a reminder that repeats every N minutes and
  stops once a session is finished that day, a "restore defaults" button, an update
  button and `instalingbot://start` / `instalingbot://stop` deep links for
  Tasker/MacroDroid.
- **iOS IPA** — unsigned build for SideStore/AltStore with the same engine, settings,
  statistics, a reminder-frequency dropdown, a repeating configurable reminder and a URL
  scheme for Shortcuts. A free Apple ID needs a refresh every 7 days.
- **Userscript** — floating panel for Safari on iOS/iPadOS and Firefox on Android, with
  a persisted settings panel (accuracy, all typing delays, navigation speed, reminder
  time and frequency, autostart), statistics, a "restore defaults" button, an in-page
  reminder banner, `?autostart=1`, `?lang=en`, GM storage and automatic updates through
  `@updateURL`. The panel is sized with `100dvh` so it stays inside Safari's viewport.

The website tags every download with OS/minimum version, architecture and format, and
detects the visitor's device (Windows, macOS ARM64/Intel, Android, iPhone, iPad, Linux)
to highlight the recommended build while keeping all alternatives. Its primary button
downloads the recommended build and scrolls to the matching install tutorial. Every
platform uses the same icon generated from `build/icon.png`.

Mobile apps do not store passwords; they reuse the normal website session in the WebView.
A session runs only while the app or browser tab is open. Every app — desktop, Android,
iOS and the userscript — shows week/month/year/all statistics; the full desktop additionally
keeps saved-word export, tray mode and hidden background sessions.

## Install

- Windows: `instaling-bot-4.2.2-setup-win64.exe` from the latest release.
- macOS: `instaling-bot-4.2.2-macos-arm64.pkg` or `instaling-bot-4.2.2-macos-x64.pkg`.
- Android: `instaling-bot-4.2.2-android.apk`.
- iOS: `instaling-bot-4.2.2-ios.ipa` (SideStore/AltStore) or `instaling-bot.user.js`.
- Linux / terminal: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bmonekkk/instaling-bot/master/install.sh | bash`

## Notes

- License: ISC.
- Language: Polish-first documentation, English README and support; every app switches
  between Polish and English.
- Installers, APK and IPA are unsigned; SmartScreen and Gatekeeper may warn on first launch.
- Mobile sessions stop when the app/tab is suspended in the background.
- The project is educational, is not affiliated with InstaLing and is not intended to cheat.
